QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Romeo's Present
QuestInfo.0: Romeo had finally received the okay to date Juliet, but he had been hard at work researching. Has he been dating well? Let's check up on #bRomeo#k.
QuestInfo.1: Romeo was still worried about what to get her, so I advised him to get Juliet a flower. Like a true alchemist, Romeo thought of the Snowfield Rose and asked me to help him get one. Thankfully, he knew how to make the seeds, so all I need to do is get the #bMay Mist#k. \n\n#i4000361##t4000361# #b#c4000361##k/20
QuestInfo.2: I found the Snowfield Rose and gave it to Romeo. Romeo told me to wait as he wants to finalize the process himself, with all his heart.
